full_prompt_en: A square conceptual photograph shows a solitary figure with a donkey head standing in profile in an almost entirely white landscape beneath a clear muted blue sky. The sky fills most of the upper frame as an unbroken field of cool blue, deepening slightly toward the top and fading to a paler tone near the horizon. Across the middle runs a low, roughly textured bank of snow, its top edge almost level and its granular surface catching a quiet wash of daylight. In front of it, the flat pale ground extends to the lower edge, interrupted by only a few faint changes of tone. The figure stands a little left of center, upright and still, facing the left side of the image. Its animal head is pale gray-white, with a long muzzle, dark eye, and two narrow ears projecting upward; the short neck meets the high collar of an oversized cream jacket. The jacket hangs loosely past the hips, its softly structured lapels, long sleeves, and straight hem readable through restrained tonal differences rather than strong outlines. Matching light trousers fall toward dark brown shoes, while one dark hand rests beside the jacket. The figure's restrained silhouette is striking against the nearly featureless sky and snow. Sunlight from the upper left brightens the pale costume and snowbank, while a long narrow blue-gray shadow stretches to the right across the foreground. The photographic rendering is crisp enough to reveal the snowy granulation and the head's surface, yet the broad color fields remain calm and uncluttered. There is no readable text. The overall composition balances a strange central presence with extensive negative space, using icy blue, warm off-white, and one low dark shadow to create an austere, dreamlike stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形观念摄影作品呈现一名长着驴头的人物，独自侧身站在近乎全白的景观中，头顶是清澈而低饱和的蓝天。天空占据画面上方的大部分面积，形成完整的冷蓝色场，向上略深，到地平线附近逐渐转淡。画面中部横贯一道低矮而粗糙的雪堤，顶部边缘几乎水平，颗粒状表面承接着安静的日光。雪堤前方，平坦浅色地面一直延伸到下缘，只有少量微弱的色调变化。人物站在中央稍偏左的位置，笔直静立，面朝画面左侧。浅灰白色的动物头部长着细长的口鼻、深色眼睛和两只向上伸出的窄耳朵；短颈接入宽松奶油色外套的高领。外套松垮地垂过臀部，略有结构的翻领、长袖和直下摆靠克制的色差而非强轮廓显现。同色浅裤垂向深棕色鞋子，一只深色的手停在外套旁。人物收敛的轮廓在近乎没有特征的天空和白雪前格外醒目。左上方的阳光照亮浅色服装与雪堤，一道细长的蓝灰色影子则横过前景，向右侧延伸。摄影式呈现清晰到能看见雪的颗粒和头部表面，但宽阔色块仍然平静、简洁。画面没有可读文字。整体构图用大片留白平衡一个奇异的中央形象，以冰蓝、暖灰白和一条低伏的暗影营造出严峻而梦幻的静止感。
style_prompt_en: The photographic image favors expansive, nearly uniform color fields and a sparse arrangement of sharply legible forms. A cool blue gradient meets a broad pale band at a simple horizontal division, while restrained warm off-white keeps the light areas from becoming purely monochrome. Surfaces hold fine natural grain, but small detail remains subordinate to the scale of the empty areas. Clean silhouettes carry the visual idea; their edges are crisp against smooth background tones and softer where similarly pale planes meet. Clear directional daylight produces gentle modeling on light surfaces and one long, narrow blue-gray shadow across the foreground. Spatial depth comes from the measured separation of horizontal bands and the dark shadow rather than busy perspective cues. The result is a quiet, surreal photographic language in which minimal color and abundant negative space make an unusual form feel both precise and isolated.
style_prompt_zh: 这种摄影画面偏爱宽阔而近乎均匀的色场，以及清晰易辨、数量稀少的形体。冷蓝色渐变在简洁的水平分界处接上一道宽阔的浅色区域，克制的暖灰白又让亮部不至于完全单色。表面保留细微的自然颗粒，但小细节始终服从大片空白的尺度。干净的剪影承担主要视觉表达；它们在平滑背景前边缘清晰，在相近的浅色平面交接处则更柔和。明确方向的日光让亮面缓慢塑形，并在前景投下一道狭长的蓝灰色阴影。空间纵深来自水平色带之间有节制的分隔和暗影，而非繁忙的透视线索。最终形成一种安静而超现实的摄影语言，以极少的色彩和充足留白令异样形态显得既精确又孤立。
theme_en: A white-clad figure with a donkey head in a stark snowy landscape
theme_zh: 荒凉雪地里一位穿白衣、长着驴头的人物
name: Andrea Galvani
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
